title: tylosema humifusum
intro: Tylosema humifusum, commonly known as the "Devil's Claw", is a plant species native to Southern Africa, known for its unique appearance and medicinal properties. The plant is used to treat various health conditions, including pain, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tylosema humifusum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and analgesic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides, especially harpagoside, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
